body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (13:5xZ). Graded **p2 · domain:skills**, queued.

Theme: MCP. Skills docs that teach authoring are in that theme, because external agents author from them. Item 5 makes this more than a nit.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md` tells an authoring agent that `admin_rescue` lets only a privileged admin act through Reassign.
- The runtime actually opens the request on the organization's administrators.
- So an agent that builds an approval from this text will describe its behaviour wrongly to the user.

Items 1–4, 6 and 7 are wording and test hygiene. They ride along in the same PR because they are cheap and in the same area. On their own they would fall under the p3 standard.
